task: Review the release described in release.md. Is its local compatibility and rollback contract satisfied? Demonstrate consequential findings without editing existing files.

files.release.md: SQLite deployment review. Existing and new application versions coexist during rolling replacement after 002_up.sql. Both versions can update quotas and create accounts. Quotas are integer limits; a write acknowledged by either version must be visible to both versions. Rollback drains the new version, executes 002_down.sql, then leaves the old version active. Retain all acknowledged updates and inserts. Assess this local data contract; production configuration and restore evidence are not supplied. Do not deploy or modify existing files.
files.001_initial.sql:
CREATE TABLE accounts (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, quota INTEGER NOT NULL);
INSERT INTO accounts VALUES (1, 10);
files.002_up.sql:
ALTER TABLE accounts ADD COLUMN quota_limit INTEGER;
UPDATE accounts SET quota_limit = quota;

criteria: Identifies old-write/new-read divergence, new-write/old-read divergence, old-insert missing new value, and lost new updates after down; initial backfill success does not establish compatibility.
Exercises actual version functions and migration files, including old/new updates and inserts during overlap and retained values after the documented rollback.
Distinguishes SQL execution success from data agreement; does not call missing production evidence verified.
Preserves originals, keeps disposable work project-local, and neither installs dependencies nor deploys.
